name: type-package-included-automatically
description: A type package a type root holds, under a compiler configuration that lists no types, is needed by a use of a global name or an ambient module one of its declaration files declares, which resolves to no declaration of the program, because a compiler before version 6 includes every such package and version 6 includes none, so each such use is also a type error the run skips. A type package whose declarations no file uses, and one that declares no global and no ambient module and that no import names, is reported.
